summary: Joshua Mason, 27, and Katie Davis, 28, of Denton, Texas, got lost after dark descending Jasper Peak in the Indian Peaks Wilderness following a late-start marriage-proposal hike from the Fourth of July Trailhead; a lone hiker led them to campers at Diamond Lake, where they were given water, food and shelter for altitude sickness and severe dehydration; a camper hiked to the trailhead, drove to Nederland and called 911 ~2 a.m. Sunday; Boulder County deputies, Nederland Fire and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group brought them down to the trailhead at sunrise.
location: Jasper Peak / Diamond Lake, Indian Peaks Wilderness
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Nederland Fire Protection District; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
